content: We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically reproduces the reaction described: Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) reaction. The forward reaction: aldehyde/ketone + phosphonate carbanion -> alkene (E) + aliphatic carboxylic acid (from phosphonate). So broken bonds: C-P and C-O (from phosphonate). Formed: C-C double bond and carboxylic acid group (aliphatic). The functional groups formed: "C-C double bonds" and "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Broken functional group: "phosphonate"? Not in list. The functional groups list includes "trimethylsilyl", etc. Phosphonate not listed. So we need to search using bonds broken/formed perhaps. Use bonds broken: "C-P", "C-O". Bonds formed: "C=C". Also functional groups formed: "C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Let's try search with bonds.
